opportunities.title: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: Full-time faculty and research staff at accredited research institutions are eligible to apply.
opportunities.fieldFit: Useful for compute-intensive HCI, human-centred AI, multimodal analytics, visualization, and XR back-end workloads.
opportunities.recommendation: Apply when the project has a quantified cloud workload, public research output, benchmark, tool, or training plan.

opportunities.title: Frontier Health and Medical Research — Extended EOI Rounds
opportunities.fundingType: Institutional health and medical research grant
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: An eligible Australian organisation submits the EOI; individual CI and organisational rules apply.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A multidisciplinary team and linked program of research are expected; the institution should lead submission planning.
opportunities.fieldFit: Conditional but potentially strong for genuinely frontier digital health, assistive XR, neurotechnology, or human–AI health systems.
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue only for an ambitious health program with major clinical need, novelty, institutional sponsorship, and a highly credible team.

opportunities.title: 2026 Primary Health Care Research Grant Opportunity
opportunities.fundingType: Institutional health and medical research grant
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: Submission is through an eligible Australian organisation; confirm stream, CI, and internal deadline requirements.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A primary-care, health-service, community, or implementation partner may be important for competitiveness.
opportunities.fieldFit: Potential fit for telehealth, equitable service access, clinician-facing interaction, patient experience, and digital care pathways.
opportunities.recommendation: Develop a proposal only after matching the HCI or digital-health problem to an explicit grant objective and implementation setting.

opportunities.funder: National Health and Medical Research Council
opportunities.title: Partnership Projects — 2026 PRC3
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: An NHMRC-approved administering institution submits; CI and application rules apply.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A genuine partner organisation and documented cash or in-kind contribution are central to this scheme.
opportunities.fieldFit: Potential fit for deployed digital health, human factors, accessibility, or XR research co-designed with a service or industry partner.
opportunities.recommendation: Prioritise when an external partner already owns the problem, can contribute resources, and can implement the research outcome.

opportunities.title: 2026 Early to Mid-Career Researchers Grant Opportunity
opportunities.deadlineLabel: 2026 round closed 19 Aug 2026 · next round watch
opportunities.fundingType: Institutional health and medical research grant
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: The 2026 round has closed. Monitor the next official MRFF/NHMRC round and confirm future EMCR rules with the Research Office.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: Scheme-specific team and organisational rules apply.
opportunities.fieldFit: Potential fit for digital health and human-centred health technology, subject to the selected research stream.
opportunities.recommendation: The 2026 round is closed; do not start a new application. Monitor the next official round.

opportunities.funder: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
opportunities.title: Australia–Korea Foundation — Next Annual Grant Round Watch
opportunities.funding: Amount to be confirmed in the next guidelines
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: Australian individuals and organisations have been eligible in prior rounds; confirm the next guidelines when released.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A Korean partner actively contributing time, resources, or funding is strongly encouraged.
opportunities.fieldFit: Strong bilateral fit for AI, robotics, advanced technology, research exchange, workshops, and public engagement rather than core lab research alone.
opportunities.recommendation: Prepare the Korean partner, public-engagement outcome, bilateral impact case, and a one-year delivery plan ahead of the next annual round.

opportunities.title: Global Science and Technology Diplomacy Fund — Korea Route Watch
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: Australian research or innovation organisations lead under round-specific rules.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A priority-country partner is required; South Korea was an eligible partner in the prior round.
opportunities.fieldFit: Strong fit when HCI or XR is framed within AI, advanced manufacturing, quantum, health technology, or another announced priority theme.
opportunities.recommendation: Maintain a Korea–Australia concept and partner team, but do not treat this as open until the official site publishes a new round.

opportunities.funder: National Research Foundation of Korea / MSIT
opportunities.title: Korea–Australia Joint Research Call Watch
opportunities.eligibilityRoute: A Korean PI and eligible Korean institution normally submit through IRIS; the Australian researcher joins under the call's overseas-partner rules.
opportunities.partnerRequirement: A Korean PI and matched bilateral proposal are normally required.
opportunities.fieldFit: Potential fit for HCI, human-centred AI, digital media, robotics, visualization, immersive systems, and interdisciplinary computing when listed in the call.
opportunities.recommendation: Search IRIS and NRF notices daily and activate only after an official Korea–Australia call, topic scope, and overseas eligibility are confirmed.
